# Robert Novell

> A comprehensive aviation history archive preserving the stories, photographs, and memoirs of pioneering aviators and historic aircraft through personal narratives and documentary evidence.

Robert Novell's site documents aviation history through first-hand accounts, extensive photo galleries, and published works focused on Wright Brothers, Pan American Airlines, the Spruce Goose, and Washington State aviation heritage. The site serves as both a personal archive and educational resource for aviation enthusiasts and historians.

## Key Topics

- Aviation History
- Wright Brothers
- Spruce Goose
- Pan American Airlines
- Historical Preservation
- Aviation Heritage
- Pangborn
- Washington State Aviation
- Huffman Prairie
- The Cycle Shop
- Historical Documentation
- Aviator Profiles
- Knowledge Sharing
- Personal Memoirs
- Aircraft Photography

## Aviation History Collections

- [Robert Novell's Books](https://www.robertnovell.com/robert-novells-books): Showcase of Robert Novell's published aviation memoirs and short story collections.
- [Photo Gallery](https://www.robertnovell.com/photo-gallery): Aviation photo gallery featuring Spruce Goose, airlines, and historical aircraft.
- [Blog](https://www.robertnovell.com/blog-2): Blog hub featuring aviation history, Pangborn, and Washington State aviation stories.

## Historic Aircraft & Airlines

- [The Spruce Goose Moves to McMinnville, Oregon – August 16, 2014](https://www.robertnovell.com/photo-gallery/the-spruce-goose-moves-to-mcminnville-oregon-august-16-2014): Documentary photography of Spruce Goose relocation to McMinnville, Oregon.
- [Pan American Airlines](https://www.robertnovell.com/photo-gallery/pan-american-airlines): Photo documentation of Pan American Airlines vintage aircraft and clipper fleet.

## Wright Brothers & Aviation Pioneers

- [My Visit With The Wright Brothers](https://www.robertnovell.com/photo-gallery/my-visit-with-the-wright-brothers): Personal narrative of visiting Wright Brothers' Cycle Shop and Huffman Prairie.
- [My Visit With The Wright Brothers – November 13, 2020](https://www.robertnovell.com/photo-gallery/my-visit-with-the-wright-brothers-2): November 2020 memoir documenting Wright Brothers landmarks in Dayton, Ohio.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.robertnovell.com): Robert Novell's homepage dedicated to aviation history preservation and knowledge sharing.

## Optional

- [America Can Be Great Again](https://www.robertnovell.com/america-can-be-great-again): Political commentary on American decline using historical analysis of empires.
- [Afghanistan … Yes or NO](https://www.robertnovell.com/afghanistan): Geopolitical analysis of US military strategy and Taliban takeover in Afghanistan.
